title: Marc Maron: Panika
plot: Ve svém druhém speciálu pro HBO přináší komik a podcasterMarc Maronsvůj osobitý pohled na náš čím dál nejistější svět.(HBO Max)

reviews.author: novoten
reviews.text: Jsou dny, kdy se v názorech na společnost, politiku, svět a jeho budoucnost nejvíc shodnu se zdánlivě mrzutým pesimistou s věčnou jiskrou v oku. Dnes je jeden z těch dní. Aljašská historka je snad to nejdrsnější, co jsem kdy ve stand-upu slyšel a žádný jiný bavič by to neustál, na to musí jeden mít odžito a odmyšleno po svém.(06.08.2025)

reviews.author: Devadesát Dva
reviews.text: Ze startu trochu politiky, ale to jen aby se neřeklo... pak oheň a útěk s kočkama. Krysy v domě.Hitler on Theo Von's podcast. Temný trauma. Smíření se smrtí skrzesongTaylor Swift. (...) "You ever been to Maron's? You got to go to Maron's. He's got a couch down there. I'm halfway through the collected works of Alexander Pope." (...) "And for some reason I looked at my dad and said: Is there anything better or more important than fucking?" And my dad, mid soup, goes "Nope."   (...) "I don't even know if I can identify happiness. I don't even know if I know what the experience feels like. I don't know if I know the difference between I'm happy and, fuck, this is good coffee. I don't know." (...) "Just get in, man. Just get in. Come on. Enough is enough. You don't even make sense anymore." (...) "So my dad, the sarge..." (entire bit kills me, the funny meets the darkest).(03.08.2025)

reviews.author: kiddo
reviews.text: All they really wanted was just to be able to say the R-word with impunity. That was why they voted. But along with that, you know, comes the collapse of the federal government, the destabilization of the global economy, tens of thousands of people being deported to places they might not even have come from, the actual suppression of speech and rights of LGBTQ people and women, and the rise of authoritarianism, and sometimes I feel like asking them, “Was it worth it, you fucking retard?”(07.09.2025)
